# Agile Counseling

> Therapy practice in Sandy, Utah, run by Candice Gonzalez, LCSW (Licensed Clinical Social Worker). Individual, child, teen and family therapy, plus EMDR for trauma. In-person at 45 W 9000 S, Ste 1, Sandy, UT 84070, and telehealth across Utah. Phone (801) 597-9558. NPI 1376050237.

## Services
- [Anxiety Therapy](https://agilecounseling.com/services/anxiety-therapy/): CBT and DBT-based care for worry, panic and social anxiety.
- [Depression Therapy](https://agilecounseling.com/services/depression-therapy/): evidence-based care for low mood and burnout.
- [Child & Teen Therapy](https://agilecounseling.com/services/child-therapy/): anxiety, ADHD, behaviour and emotional challenges, parents involved.
- [Family Counseling](https://agilecounseling.com/services/family-counseling/): communication, conflict and reconnection.
- [EMDR Therapy](https://agilecounseling.com/services/emdr-therapy/): trauma and PTSD, including a 90-minute intensive block (call for the fee).
- [LGBTQIA+ Affirming Therapy](https://agilecounseling.com/services/lgbtqia-affirming/)

## Page summaries
- Home (https://agilecounseling.com/): overview of services, areas served and how to book. Office in Sandy, Utah; telehealth statewide.
- Anxiety Therapy: therapy for generalized anxiety, social anxiety, panic and performance anxiety using CBT and DBT skills; in person or telehealth.
- Depression Therapy: evidence-based treatment for depression, low motivation and burnout, with a plan built around the client.
- Child & Teen Therapy: age-appropriate therapy for children and adolescents facing anxiety, ADHD, behavioural and emotional challenges, with parents part of the plan.
- Family Counseling: sessions for families who want better communication, less conflict and a more connected home.
- EMDR Therapy: Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing for trauma and PTSD. Standard sessions and a 90-minute intensive block are offered; the fee is given by phone.
- LGBTQIA+ Affirming Therapy: identity-affirming care for anxiety, depression, relationships and life transitions.
- Area pages (Draper, Salt Lake City, South Jordan, West Jordan, Herriman, Murray): the same services for clients travelling from those cities to the Sandy office, or meeting by telehealth.
- EMDR Therapy Guide: how EMDR works, its eight phases, who it helps and what a session feels like.
- Child Therapy in Utah guide: signs a child may benefit from therapy, what a first session involves and how parents take part.
- Resources & FAQs: common questions about starting therapy plus Utah crisis lines and mental health resources.
- Contact and Book: phone (801) 597-9558, email candice@agilecounseling.com, address 45 W 9000 S, Ste 1, Sandy, UT 84070.

## Not published here
Session fees, office hours, and the practice's founding date are not listed on the site. Call for current information.
